announcements.t: Rashtriya Chemicals and Fertilizers Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI LODR, we wish to inform that the shareholders of the Company at the 48th Annual General Meeting held on September 25, 2026 have approved the following by way of Special Resolutions:
Voting Results of 48th Annual General Meeting (AGM) held on September 25, 2026 |SUBJECT: Shareholders meeting
Summary of the Proceedings of the 48th Annual General Meeting (AGM) held on September 25,2026 |SUBJECT: Shareholders meeting
Confirmation of Redemption/Payment of Interest and Principal |SUBJECT: Confirmation of Redemption/Payment of Interest and Principal
